description: Taifoon GPU (product taifoon.gpu, live): one inference on an open model through the metered GPU gate (POST https://api.taifoon.dev/gpu/{model}/{endpoint}) with YOUR key; the gate meters tokens (chars/4) and is paid from your key’s one balance (POST /v1/access/debit) at the catalogue price: spot 0.2 USDC per 1M tokens, reserved 0.4. Lanes: nemotron/chat, auditor/generate, wizard/chat, studio/chat, and confidential/chat (_CONFIDENTIAL_LANE_v1_: Phala Private AI, the model runs in a GPU TEE; body is an OpenAI chat completion with a TEE model from GET https://api.taifoon.dev/gpu/confidential/v1/models; priced at Phala’s per-token price + 20 %; answers 503 not_configured until the owner sets the lane’s Phala key). body is the lane’s JSON (messages or prompt, max_tokens). Needs your key; no balance → 402 with how to top up (taifoon_access_topup).
name: taifoon_gpu_infer
